entries.title: Ten Band EQ
entries.description: An Equalizer (EQ) that can modify one band at a time.

entries.title: Classic EQ
entries.description: An Equalizer (EQ) that can modify more than one band at a time.

entries.title: ACX Check
entries.description: This analyzer was developed as an aid for audiobook producers. It displays a number of useful statistics about the selected audio, and compares them to the specifications published by ACX (an Amazon.com subsidiary).

entries.title: Amazon Music, Alexa Loudness Check
entries.description: Various streaming platforms and other institutions expect content to have a certain range for peaks, RMS, LUFS, noise floor or a combination of the aforementioned. These plugins provide the relevant checks for the platforms in question.

entries.title: Amplify Left or Right Channel
entries.description: Amplify or attenuate a single audio channel (Left or Right) from a stereo track

entries.title: Apple Music Loudness Check
entries.description: Various streaming platforms and other institutions expect content to have a certain range for peaks, RMS, LUFS, noise floor or a combination of the aforementioned. These plugins provide the relevant checks for the platforms in question.

entries.title: Band-Stop Filter
entries.description: A band-rejection filter that passes most frequencies unaltered, but stops those in a specific range.

entries.title: Bass to Center
entries.description: Frequency-selective filter to crossfeed (mix) bass frequencies to center (mono). Requires stereo tracks

entries.title: Bouncing Ball Delay with Panning
entries.description: Combines the Bouncing Ball Delay with a panning effect.

entries.title: Bouncing Ball Delay with Tone Shift
entries.description: Combines the Bouncing Ball Delay with Tone Shift plugins.

entries.title: Binaural Tones with Surf 2
entries.description: A sine tone of one constant frequency is generated in the left channel of a stereo track, and a series of changing tones of slightly different frequencies are generated in the right.

entries.title: Bouncing Ball Delay
entries.description: A delay plugin where, like a bouncing ball, the bounces get faster and faster.

entries.title: Stereo Butterfly (static)
entries.description: The original Stereo Butterfly plugin which can be spread wide (1, full stereo), closed (0, sounding mono), or somewhere in-between

entries.title: Stereo Butterfly (LFO)
entries.description: Second in the Stereo Butterfly series. It takes stereo audio and makes it sound like the left and right channels are switching back and forth with each other.

entries.title: Stereo Butterfly (ramp)
entries.description: Third in the series of Stereo Butterfly plugins. As with the previous two, 0 setting sounds like mono, +1 is regular stereo, -1 is left and right channels flipped with each other.

entries.title: Buzz tone generator
entries.description: Generates a nasal-sounding tone composed of the base frequency plus n-1 harmonics.

entries.title: Center Pan Remover
entries.description: Removes center-panned content in stereo tracks by inverting and making mono

entries.title: Change Speed by Semitones
entries.description: Similar to the Change Speed effect, this effect changes the speed of the selected audio, thus changing both the tempo and pitch.

entries.title: Channel Mixer
entries.description: A multi-purpose tool that can perform almost any type of channel mixing task on an unsplit stereo track.

entries.title: Chebyshev Type I Filter
entries.description: Type I Chebyshev filters can provide a steeper roll-off than Butterworth filters but at the expense of more ripple in the passband.

entries.title: Chimes delay
entries.description: Adds random delay to your audio, and randomly changes the pitch of each delay if you specify a note list.

entries.title: Club Play Loudness Check
entries.description: Various streaming platforms and other institutions expect content to have a certain range for peaks, RMS, LUFS, noise floor or a combination of the aforementioned. These plugins provide the relevant checks for the platforms in question.

entries.title: Comb Filter
entries.description: The name 'comb' filter comes from how it acts on the audio spectrum it's applied to: it looks like a comb with the teeth pointing up.

entries.title: Cross Fade In
entries.description: Cross Fade In applies a "curved" fade that is different from the linear Fade in that will result in equal RMS volume throughout the faded section when used in conjunction with the Cross Fade Out effect to perform a crossfade.

entries.title: Cross Fade Out
entries.description: Cross Fade Out applies a "curved" fade that is different from the linear Fade Out. The curve used is one that will result in equal RMS (average) volume throughout the faded section when used in conjunction with the Cross Fade In effect, to perform a crossfade.

entries.title: Hum Remover
entries.description: A filter for removing the sound of mains hum from recordings.

entries.title: Deezer Loudness Check
entries.description: Various streaming platforms and other institutions expect content to have a certain range for peaks, RMS, LUFS, noise floor or a combination of the aforementioned. These plugins provide the relevant checks for the platforms in question.

entries.title: Delay BPM with Panning
entries.description: Applies a delay effect based on a specified tempo (beats per minute), with optional panning and filtering of the delayed sound.

entries.title: Delay with Stereo Flip
entries.description: This is a stereo delay effect: with each delay, the stereo channels are flipped from left to right and vice versa.

entries.title: Delay with Pitch Change
entries.description: A delay plugin except, each delay is pitch shifted.

entries.title: Reverse Bouncing Ball Delay
entries.description: The fastest bounces come first, gradually slowing down - reverse of the Bouncing Ball Delay effect.

entries.title: Desk EQ
entries.description: This equalizer is modelled on the EQ section of the Allen & Heath GL series mixing desk.

entries.title: DTMF Tones
entries.description: Touch Tones (also known as DTMF or Dual Tone Multi Frequency Tones) are the tones made by key pads on telephones. Each tone is comprised of two separate tones at different pitch, hence "dual tone".

entries.title: DTMF Tones (random)
entries.description: Touch Tones (also known as DTMF or Dual Tone Multi Frequency Tones) are the tones made by key pads on telephones. Each tone is comprised of two separate tones at different pitch, hence "dual tone".

entries.title: Dual Tape Decks
entries.description: Simulates two tape decks playing identical tapes, but out of synchronization with each other.

entries.title: Harmonic Enhancer
entries.description: Adds high frequency harmonics to brighten very dull recordings that don't respond to Equalization.

entries.title: Customizable EQ
entries.description: Customizable single-band equalizer.

entries.title: Regular Interval Audio Splitter
entries.description: Splits audio into desired number of segments by inserting silences of specified duration (up to 10.0 seconds).

entries.title: Extract Audio
entries.description: Extracts audio from a selected area without using a mouse or cursor keys.

entries.title: Fade In and Out
entries.description: Define the length of fade-in and fade-out selections without using a mouse or cursor keys.

entries.title: Fire and Explosion sounds
entries.description: Emulates a Korg MS-10 synthesizer patch.

entries.title: Flanger (linear)
entries.description: Unlike a regular flanger (which cycles up and down repeatedly), this plugin creates a single high-frequency flange, and you can set the position of that high-frequency point, anywhere between the start and end of the selection and beyond.

entries.title: Nyquist Generate Prompt
entries.description: Nyquist Generate Prompt makes it easy for Nyquist developers to test their code for "Generate" plugins in one step.

entries.title: Harmonic Noise
entries.description: Generates approximately harmonic tones by mixing narrow bands of noise

entries.title: High Pass Filter with Q
entries.description: A high pass filter with Q, or resonance.

entries.title: Delay with High-Pass Filter
entries.description: Applies a high-pass filter to a delay so that with each subsequent delay, the filter's cut-off frequency is increased.

entries.title: High Pass Filter (LFO)
entries.description: A high pass filter with a low frequency oscillator (LFO).

entries.title: HQ-Tone
entries.description: HQ-Tone is a high quality (no alias) tone generator. This plugin is typically faster than Audacity's built-in "Square - no alias" generator, particularly for low frequencies, and provides more waveform choices.

entries.title: Hyperexp
entries.description: The Hyperexp effect is a type of compression.

entries.title: Insert Silence
entries.description: This effect inserts silence at the start of the audio selection.

entries.title: Isochronic modulator
entries.description: A variable tremolo plugin customized with controls for length and fade in/out speed of each pulse.

entries.title: KLSTRBAS
entries.description: KLSTRBAS (for "cluster bass") generates dense sounds by combining several waveforms with a fixed frequency ratio between them.

entries.title: Level Speech
entries.description: This effect is designed to mitigate problems in speech recordings where there are very large variations in the loudness / amplitude of the recorded voice or voices.

entries.title: High Pass Filter (LFO) - Alternative version
entries.description: An alternative high-pass filter whose low-frequency oscillator sweeps the cutoff frequency.

entries.title: Low Pass Filter (LFO) - Alternative version
entries.description: An alternative low-pass filter whose low-frequency oscillator sweeps the cutoff frequency.

entries.title: Limiter (Audacity <3.6)
entries.description: Use the Limiter effect to pass signals below a specified input level unaffected or gently reduced, while preventing the peaks of stronger signals from exceeding this threshold. Mastering engineers often use limiting combined with make-up gain to increase the perceived loudness of an audio recording during the audio mastering process.

entries.title: Limiter (legacy)
entries.description: A "lookahead" dynamic range limiter to compress peaks that extend beyond the set threshold value.

entries.title: Limiter (2)
entries.description: The same as Limiter except that the make up gain control is a multi-choice selection rather than a slider.

entries.title: Low Pass Filter with Q
entries.description: A low pass filter with Q, or resonance.

entries.title: Delay with Low-Pass Filter
entries.description: Applies a low-pass filter to a delay so that with each subsequent delay, the filter's cut-off frequency is reduced.

entries.title: Low Pass Filter (LFO)
entries.description: A low pass filter with a low frequency oscillator (LFO).

entries.title: Multiband EQ
entries.description: A multiband equalizer.

entries.title: Mutron
entries.description: Loosely based on the Mutron stomp box from the late 70's. Basically it is a filter controlled by an envelope follower.

entries.title: Netflix Loudness Check
entries.description: Various streaming platforms and other institutions expect content to have a certain range for peaks, RMS, LUFS, noise floor or a combination of the aforementioned. These plugins provide the relevant checks for the platforms in question.

entries.title: Narrowband Noise
entries.description: Narrowband Noise generates noise within a specified frequency range by ring-modulating a sine wave with low-pass filtered noise. The effect is like band-pass filtered noise.

entries.title: Noise Gate
entries.description: Noise Gates may be used to cut the level of noise between sections of a recording.

entries.title: Notch Filter
entries.description: A notch filter cuts out a "notch" in the spectrum of your audio.

entries.title: Panning
entries.description: This plugin will statically pan your stereo audio anywhere between left and right channels.

entries.title: Panning (LFO)
entries.description: Panning is controlled by a low frequency oscillator

entries.title: Ramp Panning
entries.description: Evenly pan your stereo audio, starting at one point in the stereo field and ending at another.

entries.title: Panning (random)
entries.description: Randomly pans stereo audio from one side of the stereo field to the other

entries.title: Parametric EQ
entries.description: A parametric equalizer is a variable equalizer effect which provides control of three parameters: amplitude, center frequency and bandwidth.

entries.title: Peak Finder rft
entries.description: Either places a single label at the first instance of a peak volume, or multiple labels at all the instances of that peak.

entries.title: Pitch Detect
entries.description: This plugin attempts to detect and display the musical pitch and frequency of the selected note. In most cases the default settings will work best. The other options are provided to handle special cases such as analyzing synthetic signals that are outside of the usual musical range.

entries.title: Pluck (Hz)
entries.description: Pluck generates a synthesized pluck tone with abrupt or gradual fade-out.

entries.title: Podcasts Loudness Check
entries.description: Various streaming platforms and other institutions expect content to have a certain range for peaks, RMS, LUFS, noise floor or a combination of the aforementioned. These plugins provide the relevant checks for the platforms in question.

entries.title: Pop Mute
entries.description: The effect is like an "upside-down" Noise Gate. Whereas a Noise Gate attenuates sounds that are below a specified threshold level, Pop Mute attenuates sounds that are above a specified threshold level.

entries.title: Pseudo-Stereo
entries.description: Creates an artificial stereo effect that can be useful for giving some "depth" to mono recordings.

entries.title: PWM
entries.description: Generates a modulated pulse tone.

entries.title: Random Amplitude Modulation
entries.description: Similar to Random Panning, this time playing around with the volume knob.

entries.title: Random Low Pass Filter
entries.description: Like someone is playing around with the cut-off frequency knob of your low pass filter.

entries.title: Random Pitch Modulation
entries.description: Randomly modulates the pitch of your audio.

entries.title: Reverse Bouncing Ball Delay with Tone Shift
entries.description: The fastest bounces come first - reverse of the Bouncing Ball Delay, and each bounce is tone shifted.

entries.title: Risset Bell
entries.description: Simulates a realistic bell tone based on the pioneering work of Jean Claude Risset.

entries.title: Repair Channel
entries.description: For repairing damage to one channel of a stereo track by overwriting the damaged region with audio from the other channel

entries.title: Resonant Filter
entries.description: A filter with low pass, high pass and band pass options with a "resonance" control.

entries.title: Broadcast Limiter II
entries.description: Gives you the possibility to overdrive an audio track without introducing ugly digital distortion noise.

entries.title: Broadcast Limiter III
entries.description: Similar to Broadcast Limiter II with an added Exciter

entries.title: Ring Modulator
entries.description: A ring modulator is a tremolo effect, but instead of using an LFO to amplitude modulate audio, an audio signal is used.

entries.title: Rndtone
entries.description: Generates random sine waves.

entries.title: Audio Selection Sequencer 2
entries.description: You can turn any short piece of imported, recorded or generated audio into a (repeated) sequence of notes based on chosen tempo, beats per sequence and semitone values. Any sound can be used.

entries.title: Shelf Filter
entries.description: A shelf filter with options for high shelf, low shelf or mid-band.

entries.title: Sliding Speed Change
entries.description: A speed change effect in which the initial and final speed may be set independently.

entries.title: Sony related Loudness Check
entries.description: Various streaming platforms and other institutions expect content to have a certain range for peaks, RMS, LUFS, noise floor or a combination of the aforementioned. These plugins provide the relevant checks for the platforms in question.

entries.title: Soundcloud Loudness Check
entries.description: Various streaming platforms and other institutions expect content to have a certain range for peaks, RMS, LUFS, noise floor or a combination of the aforementioned. These plugins provide the relevant checks for the platforms in question.

entries.title: Spotify Loudness Check (loud preset)
entries.description: Various streaming platforms and other institutions expect content to have a certain range for peaks, RMS, LUFS, noise floor or a combination of the aforementioned. These plugins provide the relevant checks for the platforms in question.

entries.title: Spotify Loudness Check
entries.description: Various streaming platforms and other institutions expect content to have a certain range for peaks, RMS, LUFS, noise floor or a combination of the aforementioned. These plugins provide the relevant checks for the platforms in question.

entries.title: SQ1 Generator Sequencer
entries.description: Algorithmic generator sequencer number 1.

entries.title: Surf-LFO
entries.description: An LFO surf generator.

entries.title: Surf-Oxy
entries.description: A surf generator inspired by Jean-Michel Jarre's album Oxygene.

entries.title: Tape Saturation Limiter
entries.description: A tape saturation simulation effect.

entries.title: Tempo Change
entries.description: This plugin allows you to change tempo making it faster or slower

entries.title: Text Envelope
entries.description: Provides an alternative to the "Envelope Tool" that is accessible for visually impaired and other users that do not use pointing devices

entries.title: Tidal Loudness Check
entries.description: Various streaming platforms and other institutions expect content to have a certain range for peaks, RMS, LUFS, noise floor or a combination of the aforementioned. These plugins provide the relevant checks for the platforms in question.

entries.title: Time Shifter
entries.description: A plugin for performing the same task as the Time Shift Tool in Audacity, without using a mouse.

entries.title: Delay with Tone Shift
entries.description: Similar to pitchshift.ny except you can define in semitones how much each delay is to be pitch shifted.

entries.title: Trim / Extend
entries.description: This plugin can trim audio from the start and/or end of a track (or track selection), or pad the start and/or end with silence, or any combination of the two.

entries.title: Trim Silence
entries.description: This plugin is for trimming excess silence from the start and/or end of tracks or audio clips.

entries.title: Tuning fork
entries.description: A software tuning fork, with a table giving C notes and their equivalent MIDI note numbers near the top of the screen.

entries.title: Turntable Warping MS
entries.description: Simulates unplugging and plugging in a turntable while it's powered, and related effects such as speeding it up before unplugging it

entries.title: Variable Tremolo
entries.description: This plugin produces a "Tremolo" effect in which the frequency and depth of the tremolo varies from an initial setting to a final setting.

entries.title: Vibrato
entries.description: This effect applies vibrato (a regular pulsating change of pitch) to the selected audio.

entries.title: Vocal reduction and isolation
entries.description: This is the vocal reduction and isolation effect that was included in Audacity prior version 3.5.

entries.title: Stereo Widener
entries.description: Gives the illusion of widening stereo audio. The effect produces different results depending on whether you are listening to the audio through speakers or headphones, and the distance stereo speakers are apart.

entries.title: YouTube Loudness Check
entries.description: Various streaming platforms and other institutions expect content to have a certain range for peaks, RMS, LUFS, noise floor or a combination of the aforementioned. These plugins provide the relevant checks for the platforms in question.
